g.text: Same frequency labels, different spectral estimates
Markers show the saved float32 PSD values; no interpolation, smoothing or amplitude floor is added.
LPSD averages overlapping, frequency-dependent segments; FFTW averages powers from one full-record transform.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: All saved values in these two spectra are positive. Differences include leakage, resolution and finite-sample variability.
